latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Easy Subtitles – Auto-Generate Captions for Videos.

- Upload video files (MP4, MOV, AVI, WebM, up to 500MB) and auto-generate subtitles using cloud GPU rendering at 1080p.
- Simple authentication: auto-setup with a free, time-limited token or use existing NEMO_TOKEN; session management included.
- Supports subtitle export, balance inquiries, upload, export monitoring, and multi-language captions.
- Robust error handling and clear feedback for common issues (file size, format, credits, rate limits, plan limits).
- Seamless mapping between user prompts and actions (edit, upload, export, status, credits).
- Guidance for common workflows (quick edit, batch processing, iterative refinements).
